title: Real Estate Investment: A Roadmap for Beginners
description: Learn the basics of real estate investment, from property purchase to REITs, financing, risks, and legal considerations.

nodes.label: What is Real Estate Investment?
nodes.description: Buying property, land, or real estate-linked securities for income or capital appreciation.

nodes.label: Types of Real Estate Investment
nodes.description: Residential, commercial, rental, land, and Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs).

nodes.label: Loans & Mortgages
nodes.description: Understand home loans, LTV ratio, EMIs, and interest rates before buying.

nodes.label: ROI & Rental Income
nodes.description: Evaluate rental yield, capital appreciation, and maintenance costs.

nodes.label: Risks
nodes.description: Illiquidity, market downturns, regulatory issues, frauds, and location risks.

nodes.label: Legal Documentation
nodes.description: Title deeds, encumbrance certificates, RERA registration, and stamp duty.

nodes.label: Test Yourself: Real Estate
nodes.description: Check your understanding of loans, ROI, risks, and documents.
